Transforms shopping_mall_seller_profiles with direct column mapping — id, shop_name, shop_description, logo_image_uri. 1:1 leaf extension with no nested relations to resolve.

Transforms shopping_mall_seller_password_resets to IShoppingMallSellerPasswordReset.ISummary with direct column mappings (id, created_at, expired_at) and one computed property (expired derived from expired_at <= now). Excluded: token (security credential), updated_at (administrative), shopping_mall_seller_id (parent context), seller relation (nested object omitted for summary).

Transforms shopping_mall_seller_password_resets with nested seller relation (IShoppingMallSeller.ISummary) resolved via INNER JOIN on shopping_mall_seller_id. Direct column mappings for id, token, expired_at, created_at, updated_at.

Direct mapping from shopping_mall_admins — all 6 properties (id, email, grade, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at) are direct column mappings with x-autobe-database-schema-property annotations. Read DTO for paginated list display. x-autobe-database-schema confirms shopping_mall_admins as source. Transformable.
Transforms shopping_mall_sellers with computed suspended/banned booleans from timestamp columns and LEFT JOIN to shopping_mall_seller_profiles for the profile field

Maps directly to shopping_mall_seller_profile_snapshots with columns id, shop_name, shop_description, logo_image, created_at. Nested sellerProfile relation resolved via BELONGS-TO JOIN to shopping_mall_seller_profiles. Immutable snapshot DTO — transformable.

Transforms shopping_mall_seller_sessions to IShoppingMallSellerSession.ISummary with direct column mappings for id, ip, href, referrer, created_at, and expired_at. seller_id excluded (context-derived from parent resource path). seller relation not expanded in ISummary.

Transforms shopping_mall_seller_profiles to IShoppingMallSellerProfile. Direct columns: id, shop_name, shop_description, logo_image_uri, created_at, updated_at. BELONGS-TO relation: seller via JOIN to shopping_mall_sellers resolved as IShoppingMallSeller.ISummary.

Transforms shopping_mall_seller_sessions to IShoppingMallSellerSession with direct column mappings (id, ip, href, referrer, created_at, expired_at) and a BELONGS-TO relation resolving seller_id to IShoppingMallSeller.ISummary
Transforms shopping_mall_customer_email_verifications with belongs-to customer relation via JOIN on shopping_mall_customer_id → IShoppingMallCustomer.ISummary

IShoppingMallAdminAuditLog is a Read DTO with x-autobe-database-schema pointing to shopping_mall_admin_audit_logs. It directly maps fields (id, action_type, target_entity_type, target_entity_id, old_value, new_value, reason, created_at) and has a BELONGS-TO relation (admin → IShoppingMallAdmin.ISummary via shopping_mall_admin_id). Transformable.
Transforms shopping_mall_admin_password_resets to IShoppingMallAdminPasswordReset.ISummary with nested admin relation (IShoppingMallAdmin.ISummary via BELONGS-TO on shopping_mall_admin_id)
Read DTO for admin password reset auditing. Direct mapping from shopping_mall_admin_password_resets with BELONGS-TO relation to shopping_mall_admins returned as IShoppingMallAdmin.ISummary.

Directly maps to shopping_mall_seller_profile_snapshots table. All fields (id, shop_name, shop_description, logo_image, created_at) are denormalized and self-contained per x-autobe-specification — no JOINs needed. Immutable, read-only snapshot data used in paginated history listings.
Transforms shopping_mall_admin_sessions with belongs-to admin relation to shopping_mall_admins
Maps to shopping_mall_admin_audit_logs with admin JOIN via shopping_mall_admin_id. Transformable.

Transforms shopping_mall_admins to IShoppingMallAdmin. Direct single-table mapping — all properties (id, email, grade, created_at, updated_at) map to columns in shopping_mall_admins. Excludes password_hash (security) and deleted_at (soft-deleted accounts treated as 404). No JOINs needed.

Full seller account Read DTO directly mapped to shopping_mall_sellers with a LEFT JOIN to shopping_mall_seller_profiles for the nested profile. All properties annotated with x-autobe-database-schema-property. Transformable.

Transforms shopping_mall_product_images to IShoppingMallProductImage.ISummary with direct column-to-property mapping for id, image_url, display_order, and created_at. Used for gallery rendering in search results, category listings, and product detail pages.
Transforms shopping_mall_admin_sessions to IShoppingMallAdminSession with nested admin summary (IShoppingMallAdmin.ISummary) from shopping_mall_admins

IShoppingMallCategory is a read DTO mapping directly to the shopping_mall_categories table. All scalar columns (id, name, description, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at) map directly. Relations (parent, children) are recursive self-JOINs on the same table via parent_id foreign key.
ISummary DTO directly maps to shopping_mall_product_variant_option_values with 1:1 field mapping (id, key, value, created_at, updated_at). Read DTO used for list displays within variant context.

IShoppingMallProductImage maps to shopping_mall_product_images with a joined IShoppingMallProduct.ISummary via FK. All columns (id, image_url, display_order, created_at, updated_at) map directly. The product is resolved via BELONGS-TO join on shopping_mall_product_id.

Direct column mapping from shopping_mall_inventory_records: id, quantity_change, reason, created_at, shopping_mall_product_variant_id. No JOIN expansions needed — the variant parent is known from path parameters. Records are immutable and append-only; this summary is read-only. Transformable.

Transforms shopping_mall_products with computed properties: thumbnail_image_url (derived from product_images), min_variant_price and max_variant_price (computed from product_variants), average_rating and review_count (computed from review_reviews), is_purchasable (computed from inventory_records), and nested seller summary relation
Direct mapping from shopping_mall_product_variant_option_values. Read-only response DTO with all fields mapping 1:1 to database columns (id, key, value, created_at, updated_at).

Transforms shopping_mall_products with nested category (shopping_mall_categories), seller profile (shopping_mall_seller_profiles via shopping_mall_sellers), images (shopping_mall_product_images), variants with option values and computed stock (shopping_mall_product_variants + shopping_mall_product_variant_option_values + shopping_mall_inventory_records), reviews with customer attribution (shopping_mall_review_reviews + shopping_mall_customers), and computed average_rating and review_count
Transforms shopping_mall_product_snapshot_images with optional originalImage join to IShoppingMallProductImage.ISummary

Direct mapping from shopping_mall_product_snapshot_images table. Immutable Read DTO with all properties mapped to database columns (id, shopping_mall_product_snapshot_id, shopping_mall_product_image_id, image_url, display_order, created_at). Transformable.

Transforms shopping_mall_wishlist_items with nested customer (IShoppingMallCustomer.ISummary from shopping_mall_customers) and product (IShoppingMallProduct.ISummary from shopping_mall_products) relations. Computed fields like thumbnail_image_url, min/max_variant_price, average_rating, review_count, and is_purchasable come from product's own transformer.
Transforms shopping_mall_inventory_records to IShoppingMallInventoryRecord with nested variant summary via JOIN on shopping_mall_product_variants

Transforms shopping_mall_product_snapshots to IShoppingMallProductSnapshot.ISummary with nested category (LEFT JOIN on shopping_mall_categories), snapshotImages (composed via shopping_mall_product_snapshot_images), and variantSnapshots (composed via shopping_mall_product_variant_snapshots).

Transforms shopping_mall_product_variants with direct column mappings (id, code, price, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at), composed optionValues from child table shopping_mall_product_variant_option_values, and computed fields (base_price from parent product, stock_quantity from inventory ledger)

Transformable: Direct mapping from shopping_mall_orders (id, code, total_price, status, created_at) with a BELONGS-TO join to shopping_mall_customers for the nested customer summary field. All three criteria met — Read DTO for list display, DB-backed via x-autobe-database-schema annotation, and direct table mapping to shopping_mall_orders.

Maps to shopping_mall_wishlist_items. Direct columns: id, created_at, updated_at. Nested product resolves via JOIN to shopping_mall_products → IShoppingMallProduct.ISummary (with seller+profile sub-joins, computed thumbnail/price-range/rating fields). Transformable.

Maps directly to shopping_mall_product_variant_snapshots table. Direct column mappings: id, sku_code, option_values, price, stock_quantity, created_at. JOINs: variant → shopping_mall_product_variants, productSnapshot → shopping_mall_product_snapshots (nullable). Immutable snapshot DTO for history listings — fully DB-backed and transformable.

Transforms shopping_mall_product_snapshots to IShoppingMallProductSnapshot with nested category (via JOIN on shopping_mall_category_id → IShoppingMallCategory.ISummary, nullable when category deleted), snapshot images (composed from shopping_mall_product_snapshot_images ordered by display_order), and variant snapshots (composed from shopping_mall_product_variant_snapshots). Immutable Read DTO — append-only audit records, never updated or deleted.
Transforms shopping_mall_product_variants to IShoppingMallProductVariant.ISummary with derived stock_quantity from inventory records and nested optionValues from variant_option_values

Transforms shopping_mall_categories to IShoppingMallCategory.ISummary. All fields directly map to shopping_mall_categories columns (id, name, description, parent_id, created_at, updated_at). children_count is an aggregation computed from the children relation (COUNT WHERE deleted_at IS NULL). Filtered to only active categories (deleted_at IS NULL).

Transforms shopping_mall_orders to IShoppingMallOrder with nested customer, order items (each with product/variant/seller snapshots, cancellation/refund requests), and shipments with carrier/tracking details.

Transforms shopping_mall_order_items to IShoppingMallOrderItem.ISummary with direct column mappings (id, quantity, price, status, created_at, updated_at) and belongs-to relations (order → IShoppingMallOrder.ISummary, productVariant → IShoppingMallProductVariant.ISummary).

Maps to shopping_mall_cart_items as primary table with direct columns (id, quantity, created_at, updated_at) and a BELONGS-TO join to shopping_mall_product_variants for productVariant. Computed fields (subtotal, available, unavailable_reason) are derived at query time. Transformable.

Immutable seller profile snapshot DTO with direct mapping to shopping_mall_order_item_seller_snapshots. Preserves shop_name, logo_image_url, and created_at from the database table. The x-autobe-database-schema annotation confirms the table mapping. All three transformable criteria satisfied: Read DTO (immutable snapshot for order item context), DB-backed (data comes directly from database queries), and direct table mapping (all fields map 1:1 to columns).
Transforms shopping_mall_cart_items to IShoppingMallCartItem with customer summary and product variant summary relations, plus computed available flag

Transforms shopping_mall_order_item_variant_snapshots to IShoppingMallOrderItemVariantSnapshot with nested orderItem relation. Read-only immutable snapshot with direct column mappings (id, sku_code, option_values, price, created_at) and a belongs-to JOIN to shopping_mall_order_items via the orderItem field.

Transforms shopping_mall_refund_requests to IShoppingMallRefundRequest.ISummary with nested orderItem (IShoppingMallOrderItem.ISummary) BELONGS-TO relation. Direct columns: id, reason, status, created_at, responded_at.

Transforms shopping_mall_cancellation_requests to IShoppingMallCancellationRequest with nested orderItem (BELONGS-TO via shopping_mall_order_items → IShoppingMallOrderItem.ISummary) and snapshots (HAS-MANY from shopping_mall_cancellation_request_snapshots). Status values: pending, approved, rejected. Soft-delete via deleted_at.

Transforms shopping_mall_shipments with BELONGS-TO joins to order (IShoppingMallOrder.ISummary) and seller (IShoppingMallSeller.ISummary), plus HAS-MANY eager-load of orderItems (IShoppingMallOrderItem[]). Transformable.

Read DTO (ISummary), DB-backed from shopping_mall_order_item_product_snapshot_images with direct mapping of all four columns (id, image_url, display_order, created_at). x-autobe-database-schema confirms. All transformable criteria met.

Transforms shopping_mall_refund_requests to IShoppingMallRefundRequest with nested orderItem relation (IShoppingMallOrderItem.ISummary). Direct columns: id, reason, status, responded_at, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at. BELONGS-TO relation: orderItem via shopping_mall_order_item_id JOIN to shopping_mall_order_items.

Transforms shopping_mall_order_item_product_snapshots with nested productSnapshotImages relation. All fields map directly from the table — denormalized name, description, base_price, category_name, and nullable FK references. Includes HAS-MANY join to shopping_mall_order_item_product_snapshot_images for the image gallery.

Direct mapping from shopping_mall_cancellation_request_snapshots. All columns (id, reason, status, created_at) map directly to table fields, with a BELONGS-TO relation to cancellationRequest via shopping_mall_cancellation_request_id FK. Immutable audit record — fully transformable.

Transforms shopping_mall_shipments into IShoppingMallShipment.ISummary with nested order (BELONGS-TO via shopping_mall_order_id), seller (BELONGS-TO via shopping_mall_seller_id), and orderItems (HAS-MANY via shopping_mall_order_items where shopping_mall_shipment_id matches). The deliveryStatus is derived from delivered_at (null → 'pending', non-null → 'delivered'). Direct columns: id, carrier_name, tracking_number, created_at, delivered_at.

Snapshot DTO with direct 1:1 column mapping to shopping_mall_review_review_snapshots. Every property (id, rating, content, created_at) maps to its corresponding database column via x-autobe-database-schema-property annotations. Read-only entity with no nested relations to transform.
Transforms shopping_mall_review_reviews to IShoppingMallReviewReview.ISummary with nested customer and product summaries via BELONGS-TO relations

Transforms shopping_mall_review_reviews into IShoppingMallReviewReview with nested BELONGS-TO relations (customer→IShoppingMallCustomer.ISummary, product→IShoppingMallProduct.ISummary, order→IShoppingMallOrder.ISummary, orderItem→IShoppingMallOrderItem.ISummary) and HAS-MANY composition (snapshots→IShoppingMallReviewReviewSnapshot[]). Direct columns: id, rating, content, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at.

Transforms shopping_mall_product_variant_snapshots to IShoppingMallProductVariantSnapshot.ISummary with direct column mappings (id, sku_code, option_values, price, stock_quantity, created_at) and a belongs-to relation to shopping_mall_product_variants via the variant field.

Summary read DTO with direct 1:1 column mapping to shopping_mall_review_review_snapshots. All properties (id, rating, content, created_at) correspond to database columns with x-autobe-database-schema-property annotations. No nested objects or computed fields — pure column-to-property projection.

Transforms shopping_mall_cancellation_request_snapshots to IShoppingMallCancellationRequestSnapshot.ISummary with direct field mapping: id, reason, status, created_at. Immutable audit records created at seller response time, read-only summary for paginated list display. No relations required — parent cancellation request identity is known from nested endpoint path context.
Transforms shopping_mall_refund_request_snapshots with nested refundRequest (JOIN to shopping_mall_refund_requests) and seller (JOIN to shopping_mall_sellers) relations

Transforms shopping_mall_cancellation_requests with a BELONGS-TO relation to orderItem (IShoppingMallOrderItem.ISummary) resolved via JOIN on shopping_mall_order_item_id. Direct column mappings: id, reason, status, created_at.

Read DTO directly backed by shopping_mall_refund_request_snapshots. Direct columns: id, reason, status, created_at. BELONGS-TO relation: seller (shopping_mall_sellers via seller_id). All 5 properties required. Transformable.

Transforms shopping_mall_order_item_product_snapshot_images with nested productSnapshot summary join. All fields are direct column mappings — id, image_url→imageUrl, display_order→displayOrder, created_at→createdAt. The productSnapshot is a belongs-to join via shopping_mall_order_item_product_snapshot_id.

Transforms shopping_mall_order_items with nested BELONGS-TO relations (order→IShoppingMallOrder.ISummary, variant→IShoppingMallProductVariant.ISummary, shipment→IShoppingMallShipment.ISummary|null), 1:1 snapshot relations (productSnapshot, variantSnapshot, sellerSnapshot), and HAS-MANY collections (cancellationRequests, refundRequests)

Read DTO for API response display in nested contexts. All fields have direct x-autobe-database-schema-property mappings to shopping_mall_order_item_product_snapshots columns (id, name, description, base_price→basePrice, category_name→categoryName, created_at→createdAt). Single primary table with atomic field mappings — no complex joins required at the transformer level.

import { TypedBody, TypedRoute } from "@nestia/core";
import { Controller, Ip } from "@nestjs/common";
import typia from "typia";

import { IShoppingMallGuest } from "../../../../api/structures/IShoppingMallGuest";
import { postShoppingMallAuthGuestJoin } from "../../../../providers/postShoppingMallAuthGuestJoin";
import { postShoppingMallAuthGuestRefresh } from "../../../../providers/postShoppingMallAuthGuestRefresh";

@Controller("/shoppingMall/auth/guest")
export class ShoppingmallAuthGuestController {
  /**
   * Register or identify a guest visitor using a device fingerprint and obtain JWT session tokens.
   *
   * This endpoint serves as the entry point for all unauthenticated visitors to the platform. Guests identify themselves via a unique device fingerprint — a string generated from client-side device characteristics (browser, OS, screen resolution, etc.). import { TypedBody, TypedRoute } from "@nestia/core";
import { Controller } from "@nestjs/common";
import typia from "typia";

import { IPageIShoppingMallProduct } from "../../../../../api/structures/IPageIShoppingMallProduct";
import { IShoppingMallProduct } from "../../../../../api/structures/IShoppingMallProduct";
import { CustomerAuth } from "../../../../../decorators/CustomerAuth";
import { CustomerPayload } from "../../../../../decorators/payload/CustomerPayload";
import { patchShoppingMallCustomerSearchProducts } from "../../../../../providers/patchShoppingMallCustomerSearchProducts";

@Controller("/shoppingMall/customer/search/products")
export class ShoppingmallCustomerSearchProductsController {
  /**
   * Search for products across the entire marketplace using text search, category, price range, and stock availability filters.
   *
   * The search endpoint provides the primary product discovery mechanism for customers. Results include products from all approved sellers whose accounts are not suspended or banned. Soft-deleted products are excluded from results. The search supports trigram-based fuzzy matching on product names, allowing customers to find products even with partial or approximate search terms.
   *
   * Filters can be combined — applying multiple filters simultaneously returns only products matching all criteria. When a category filter is applied, products in the specified category and all its direct subcategories are included in results. The in-stock only filter restricts results to products with at least one variant having positive stock, computed from the ledger-based inventory system.
   *
   * Results are paginated and can be sorted by newest first, price ascending, or price descending. Each result includes the product's main thumbnail image, name, price information, seller shop name, and average customer rating. Products without any variants are included in results but displayed as unavailable for purchase.
   *
   * @param connection
   * @param body Search criteria including optional text query, category filter, price range (minimum and maximum), in-stock only toggle, sort preference, and pagination parameters.
   * @x-autobe-authorization-type null
   * @x-autobe-authorization-actor customer
   * @x-autobe-specification Query the shopping_mall_products table with the following rules:
   *
   * **Visibility Filtering (MUST apply before any user-requested filters):**
   * - Exclude products where deleted_at IS NOT NULL (soft-deleted products)
   * - Exclude products whose seller has suspended_at IS NOT NULL (suspended seller's products are hidden)
   * - Exclude products whose seller has banned_at IS NOT NULL (banned seller's products are hidden)
   *
   * **Text Search:**
   * - When a search query is provided in the request body, perform trigram-based fuzzy matching on the product name column using the GIN index (gin_trgm_ops)
   * - When no search query is provided, return all visible products (subject to other filters)
   *
   * **Category Filter:**
   * - When a category ID is specified, include products where shopping_mall_category_id matches either the specified category OR any of its direct child subcategories
   * - Query the shopping_mall_categories table to resolve subcategory IDs (WHERE parent_id = specifiedCategoryId), then use IN clause on shopping_mall_category_id
   * - Uncategorized products are always included in search results when no category filter is applied
   *
   * **Price Range Filter:**
   * - When a minimum price is specified, include only products whose base_price >= minimum price
   * - When a maximum price is specified, include only products whose base_price <= maximum price
   * - When both are specified, include products where base_price BETWEEN min AND max
   *
   * **In-Stock Only Filter:**
   * - When the in-stock only filter is true, include only products that have at least one non-deleted variant (deleted_at IS NULL on shopping_mall_product_variants) with positive stock
   * - Stock is computed by summing quantity_change from shopping_mall_inventory_records for each variant — a variant has stock > 0 when SUM(quantity_change) > 0
   * - Use a subquery or EXISTS clause: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shopping_mall_product_variants v WHERE v.shopping_mall_product_id = p.id AND v.deleted_at IS NULL AND (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ir.quantity_change), 0) FROM shopping_mall_inventory_records ir WHERE ir.shopping_mall_product_variant_id = v.id) > 0)
   *
   * **Sorting:**
   * - 'newest': ORDER BY created_at DESC
   * - 'price_asc': ORDER BY base_price ASC
   * - 'price_desc': ORDER BY base_price DESC
   * - Default when no sort specified: ORDER BY created_at DESC (newest first)
   *
   * **Pagination:**
   * - Use cursor-based pagination for performance on large result sets
   * - Return total count reflecting only filtered results (not unfiltered total)
   *
   * **Building Summary DTOs (IShoppingMallProduct.ISummary):**
   * For each product in the result set:
   * - Product ID, name, base_price: from shopping_mall_products
   * - Main thumbnail image: SELECT image_url FROM shopping_mall_product_images WHERE shopping_mall_product_id = p.id ORDER BY display_order ASC LIMIT 1 — use this as the thumbnail URL; null if no images exist
   * - Seller shop name: JOIN shopping_mall_sellers s ON p.shopping_mall_seller_id = s.id, LEFT JOIN shopping_mall_seller_profiles sp ON sp.shopping_mall_seller_id = s.id, use sp.shop_name
   * - Average rating: SELECT COALESCE(AVG(r.rating), 0) FROM shopping_mall_review_reviews r WHERE r.shopping_mall_product_id = p.id AND r.deleted_at IS NULL — return as a float; if no reviews exist, return null to indicate "no rating"
   * - Price range: if the product has multiple non-deleted variants with different effective prices (using base_price as default when variant price is null), compute min and max effective prices across variants; if all variants share the same effective price or there is only one variant, show a single price
   *
   * **Performance Considerations:**
   * - Use LEFT JOINs for seller profile and category lookups
   * - The GIN trigram index on product name supports efficient fuzzy text search
   * - Apply visibility filters early to minimize the working set
   * - Evaluate in-stock filter via EXISTS subquery to avoid full inventory summation for every product
   *
   * **Edge Cases:**
   * - When no products match the search criteria, return an empty page with total count 0
   * - When a product has no images, the thumbnail field in the summary is null
   * - When a product has no reviews, the average rating field is null
   * - When a seller has no seller profile or no shop_name, display a fallback or null
   * @nestia Generated by Nestia - https://github.com/samchon/nestia
   */
  @TypedRoute.Patch()
  public async search(
    @CustomerAuth()
    customer: CustomerPayload,
    @TypedBody()
    body: IShoppingMallProduct.IRequest,
  ): Promise<IPageIShoppingMallProduct.ISummary> {
    try {
      return await patchShoppingMallCustomerSearchProducts({
        customer,
        body,
      });
    } catch (error) {
      console.log(error);
      throw error;
    }
  }
}
